# Sensitivity Level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SensitivityLevel`](gmeow-SensitivityLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SensitivityLevel>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

A privacy-sensitivity classification for a value — an open, ordered value vocabulary (public ≺ internal ≺ confidential ≺ restricted ≺ sensitive personal). The explicit facet that drives disclosure-control decisions: a value marked sensitive personal may be coarsened or withheld at projection time under a consent guard. Orthogonal to determinacy, confidence, and granularity ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). The sensitivity-to-coarsen trigger is a solver concern (P12).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SensitivityLevel`](gmeow-SensitivityLevel.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
